description: John Lienhard's asmejour class v1.27 (2025/11/30, CTAN and MiKTeX package asmejour, MIT licence), the ASME journal paper layout: extarticle at 9pt, twoside, two columns started by \maketitle, on ASME's 215.9 x 285.7 mm page. No options: the template's (balance,nocopyright,upint,varvw,hyphenate,barcolor=Goldenrod3,german) demonstrate features, and upint and hyphenate are pdfTeX-only. The class is written for pdfLaTeX and LuaLaTeX; XeTeX takes its non-pdfTeX branch, which loads unicode-math (with fontspec) and sets TeX Gyre Termes X, TeX Gyre Heros, Inconsolatazi4 and STIX Two Math by file name (asmejour.cls l.352-400; all in MiKTeX: newtx, tex-gyre, tex-gyre-math, inconsolata, stix2-otf, xits, lete-sans-math). The preamble uses the class's own title-block commands, as the template does: \JourName fills the 'Journal of ...' footer, which is otherwise blank, and one \SetAuthorBlock gives \maketitle an author. The class's \author stops with an error ('the \author command is not used', l.1709-1714); this setting does not change that.
preamble: \SetAuthorBlock{A. N. Author}{Department of Mechanical Engineering,\\Sample University,\\Sample City}
